component.name: Notion Recorder
component.summary: No-echo meeting audio for Notion AI Meeting Notes

description.p: Notion Recorder creates a private, capture-only microphone that mixes your voice with your meeting and system audio, so Notion AI Meeting Notes transcribes both sides of a call in one input.

The mix is never routed back to your speakers or headphones, so remote participants never hear an echo. Start it before a transcript, stop it after, and your original default microphone is restored automatically.

ul.li: One-click virtual microphone that combines your mic and system sound
Live circular level meters for your voice and the meeting audio
Friendly device pickers, with the currently applied devices always shown
Capture-only routing that produces no feedback for meeting participants
Optional mic-activity daemon that auto-starts and stops the mix
Optional system-tray icon to start or stop the mix from the top bar

description.p: The virtual input can be selected by any application that records from a microphone, though the guided workflow is tuned for Notion.
First release: guided no-echo meeting mix, live meters, friendly device pickers, and an audio-flow diagram.
